basic_details.job_title: Gauhati University Web Developer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Gauhati University, Guwahati is filling 1 Web Developer post on a purely contractual basis at a consolidated remuneration of ₹50,000/- a month, initially for eleven (11) months. Indian citizens with a Bachelor's Degree in a listed computing or allied discipline (or any Bachelor's Degree with a recognised web/software development certification or diploma) and at least 2 years of hands-on website and CMS experience can apply online through the Gauhati University Non-Teaching Recruitment Candidate Portal from 23 November 2026 until 8 December 2026 (midnight).

age_limit.details: Candidates must be not less than 21 years and not more than 45 years as on the last date of submission of application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. | For the full eligibility wording, candidates can check the official notification.

qualification.details: Bachelor's Degree in any of the following: | Computer Science / Computer Applications Information Technology Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Instrumentation Engineering or Technology Any other relevant discipline with substantial exposure to web technologies | OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with recognised certification/diploma in Web Development / Software Development / Information Technology.

how_to_apply: Apply online only through the Gauhati University Non-Teaching Recruitment Candidate Portal (https://gauhatint.samarth.edu.in/); no other means or mode of submission is accepted.
Register with a valid email ID and mobile number that will remain active throughout the recruitment process, as all communications are made through the registered contact details.
Fill in all required details carefully; fields marked as mandatory must be filled, and incomplete applications or applications without required information shall be summarily rejected.

Pay the application fee of ₹500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) online at the time of submission. No other mode of payment is accepted, and the fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances.
Submit the application; after final submission, no changes shall be entertained.
All relevant certificates, degrees, mark sheets and experience certificates in original, at the time of verification (Skill Test/Interview).
A "No Objection Certificate" from the present employer, wherever applicable, for candidates in employment, at the time of Interview, if called for.
important_instructions: Registration of candidature is provisional; eligibility of shortlisted candidates will be verified from original documents at the time of Skill Test/Interview. Candidates who fail to produce original certificates at verification may not be allowed to appear for the Interview. Candidates in employment who fail to produce a No Objection Certificate at the Interview, wherever applicable, may not be allowed to appear. Candidature may be cancelled at any stage, or even after joining, if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria. Candidates found indulging in canvassing in any form shall be disqualified. The University reserves the right to withdraw the advertised post at any time without assigning any reason, and either to fill or not to fill the post. The University shall not be responsible for any delay or non-receipt of communication due to technical or other reasons.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible Indian citizens. Candidates must hold the required qualifications and experience as on the last date of submission of application; those who do not possess the requisite qualification as on the closing date are not eligible. Bachelor's Degree in any of the following: Computer Science / Computer Applications Information Technology Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Instrumentation Engineering or Technology Any other relevant discipline with substantial exposure to web technologies OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with recognised certification/diploma in Web Development / Software Development / Information Technology. Minimum 2 (two) years of hands-on experience in: Website development or maintenance; and Working with Content Management System (CMS)-based websites. Experience may be gained through employment, contractual engagement, institutional projects or documented project-based work. Experience managing institutional or academic websites. Experience with multi-site structures. Exposure to accessibility or compliance-oriented platforms. Experience in documenting workflows and governance standards. Candidates must be not less than 21 years and not more than 45 years as on the last date of submission of application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. For the full eligibility wording, candidates can check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Web Developer receives a consolidated monthly remuneration of ₹50,000/-. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of this amount. The post is purely contractual in nature and initially for a period of eleven (11) months, renewable based on performance and institutional requirement. The selected candidate shall have no claim for regular appointment in the University against any permanent post by virtue of this engagement.

content_sections.heading: Gauhati University Web Developer Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these key responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain the University's central website and related sub-sites. Define and enforce the visual identity and layout standards of the website, including colours, typography, spacing, and accessibility considerations. Develop and maintain custom website themes and templates aligned with institutional branding. Configure and manage block-based content editing systems, reusable page layouts, and global templates. Evaluate, configure, update, and maintain website plugins or extensions in a secure and controlled manner. Develop custom plugins or modules where institutional requirements cannot be met through existing solutions. Manage website updates, backups, performance optimisation, and security best practices. Support the rollout and maintenance of departmental and administrative sub-sites under a common governance framework. Provide technical guidance and training to support staff and departmental users. Maintain technical documentation related to website architecture, workflows, and standards.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gauhati University Web Developer
content_sections.text: Apply online only through the Gauhati University Non-Teaching Recruitment Candidate Portal (https://gauhatint.samarth.edu.in/); no other means or mode of submission is accepted. Complete online registration between 23.11.2026 and 08.12.2026 (midnight). Register with a valid email ID and mobile number that will remain active throughout the recruitment process, as all communications are made through the registered contact details. Fill in all required details carefully; fields marked as mandatory must be filled, and incomplete applications or applications without required information shall be summarily rejected. Pay the application fee of ₹500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) online at the time of submission. No other mode of payment is accepted, and the fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances. Submit the application; after final submission, no changes shall be entertained. All relevant certificates, degrees, mark sheets and experience certificates in original, at the time of verification (Skill Test/Interview). A "No Objection Certificate" from the present employer, wherever applicable, for candidates in employment, at the time of Interview, if called for.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process may consist of: Written Test (if required for shortlisting in case of a large number of applications) Practical Skill Test Personal Interview Mere fulfilment of minimum eligibility criteria shall not entitle a candidate to be called for Written Test, Skill Test or Interview. The decision of the Screening Committee regarding shortlisting of candidates shall be final and binding, and the University reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for further stages in case of a large number of applications. The Skill Test shall be practical and task-based, designed to assess real-world technical competence in institutional website and web application development and maintenance. Candidates shall work primarily within existing codebases and pre-configured sites, rather than building from scratch. A short objective (multiple-choice) component may also be included alongside the practical tasks. The test shall be conducted on a pre-configured Linux workstation with: Web Server: Apache 2.4 Database: MySQL-compatible (MariaDB 10.x); SQLite also available for application tasks PHP: 8.x CMS: WordPress (pre-installed and configured) Python: 3.12, with Django, Flask, and FastAPI Tools: VS Code editor and a web browser for testing locally hosted sites All required dependencies shall be pre-installed and candidates shall not be required to set up environments. Reference to official technical documentation (e.g. PHP, MySQL/MariaDB, WordPress, Django, Flask, FastAPI) shall be permitted during the test. PHP and MySQL: writing and modifying PHP 8 code (procedural and object-oriented); handling HTML forms, sessions and server-side input validation; database access through PDO or MySQLi using prepared statements; writing SQL for basic schema design, CRUD operations, joins and simple indexing; reading, debugging and extending PHP code written by someone else. WordPress (CMS): creating or modifying structured page layouts based on given design specifications; working with theme templates, reusable blocks and layout components, including editing or extending PHP template code and hooks; configuring dynamic content sections (e.g. news, notices, events); managing user roles and permissions; making informed decisions on plugins/extensions from a security and maintainability perspective. Python Web Frameworks (Django / Flask / FastAPI): extending an existing application (adding fields, models, views, routes or forms); implementing input handling and server-side validation; querying and persisting data through the framework's ORM or database layer. Web Fundamentals: semantic HTML, responsive CSS layouts and Bootstrap based design; basic JavaScript for client-side interaction. Security Awareness: identifying and mitigating common web vulnerabilities with reference to the OWASP Top Ten, such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), cross-site request forgery (CSRF), insecure file uploads and broken access control.
